description: This file contains classes, functions, and constants related to managing and summarizing test run results for layout tests, including handling expectations, failures, and generating summaries.

classes.name: TestRunException
classes.description: Custom exception class for test run errors, holding an error code and message.

classes.name: TestRunResults
classes.description: Class to store and manage the results of a test run, including counts, expectations, and detailed test results.

classes.name: RunDetails
classes.description: Class to encapsulate details about a test run, including exit code and various result summaries.

methods.name: _interpret_test_failures
methods.description: Function to interpret a list of test failure objects into a dictionary of failure types.

methods.name: summarize_results
methods.description: Function to generate a summary dictionary of test run results, including counts, test hierarchies, and metadata.
